caption: The drawing shows a single male figure standing on a rectangular green pedestal. The figure appears to be a wooden mannequin or marionette with articulated joints. He wears a green hat with a wide brim, a green tunic with gray trim, and green billowy pants tied at the waist with a sash that is a light grayish-blue color. The figure’s boots are brown and wide at the top, with tan stockings visible above them. The man's right arm is extended outward, bent at the elbow with a closed hand, while his left arm is slightly bent and closer to his body, with the palm open. The clothes are accentuated with brown and silverish sections, and the facial features include a mustache, a beard, and dark hair. The background is plain and uncolored. The name “FLORIAN ROKITA” is written in small capital letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Cigar Store Figure
